enum.name: REMOTE_SYSTEM
enum.description: The system id of a remote computer

enum.name: ARMED
enum.description: The armed state at various places

message.name: COMMAND_MANUAL_TRANSITION
message.description: Commands a manual state transition on the receiving system
message.field: The system this command is for
The index in the state path where the new state should end up at
The state to which the state machine should transition

message.name: COMMAND_MANUAL_ACTUATOR
message.description: Commands a specific actuator to move to a specific target position. This is echoed back using "actuator states" messages. The actuator id can be found in the docs there, and so can the semantics of the value.
message.field: The system this command is for
The target value of the actuator. This depends on the actuator type, for valves 0.0 is fully closed and 1.0 is fully open
The index in the state path where the current state is. For the initial state this is 0 and increments with every transition.
The id of the actuator as zero padded utf8.

message.name: CURRENT_STATE
message.description: This message signals the current state machine state of the sending system
message.field: The unix timestamp when this message was created
The index in the state path where the current state is. For the initial state this is 0 and increments with every transition.
The name of the current state

message.name: BUILD_INFORMATION
message.description: This message signals the build information of a system component (board or computer)
message.field: Firmware version information
Indicates if the git repository was dirty at build time (1=true / 0=false)
Whether the build is a release build (1=true / 0=false)
CAN library version information (major, minor, patch)
Whether the build includes debugging defmt over RTT (1=true / 0=false)
Initials of the person who compiled the firmware, or `\0\0` if not set.

message.name: CONFIG_INFORMATION
message.description: This message signals the hash of the config file that was loaded at startup of the computer
message.field: The first 7 hex digits of the config file hash

message.name: FC_STATUS
message.description: This message signals the arming and health status of the rocket
message.field: The unix timestamp when this message was created
Whether the recovery actuators could receive power
Whether the main valves are receiving power
Whether the FC is in a software-armed state for launch
Whether the FC thinks the RFS is in a software-armed state
Whether the FC is active regarding PSS (i.e. not passive) (0=passive, 1=active)
Whether the FC thinks the RFS is active regarding PSS (0=passive, 1=active)
The raw separation output signal of the CATS (0=low, 1=high)
The raw deployment output signal of the CATS (0=low, 1=high)
Time since the last message from the telemetry link in deciseconds (0.1s). Saturates at 255.
Time since the last healthy message from the remote filling station in deciseconds (0.1s). Saturates at 65535.
Time since the last healthy message from the sensor carrier in deciseconds (0.1s). Saturates at 255.
Time since the last healthy message from the power board in deciseconds (0.1s). Saturates at 255.
Time since the last healthy message from the recovery board in deciseconds (0.1s). Saturates at 255.
Time since the last healthy message from the fuel control board in deciseconds (0.1s). Saturates at 255.
Time since the last healthy message from the oxidizer control board in deciseconds (0.1s). Saturates at 255.
Time since the last healthy message from the engine control board in deciseconds (0.1s). Saturates at 255.
A rolling ascii buffer which can be written to to show various messages. Zero padded, last characters are newest.

message.name: RFS_STATUS
message.description: This message signals the arming and health status of the RFS
message.field: The unix timestamp when this message was created
Whether the valves are receiving power
Whether the spark plug is receiving power
Whether the RFS is in a software-armed state for ignition
Whether the RFS thinks the FC is in a software-armed state
Whether the RFS is active regarding PSS (i.e. not passive) (0=passive, 1=active)
Whether the RFS thinks the FC is active regarding PSS (0=passive, 1=active)
Time since the last healthy message from the flight computer in deciseconds (0.1s). Saturates at 255.
Time since the last healthy message from the fuel control board in deciseconds (0.1s). Saturates at 255.
Time since the last healthy message from the oxidizer control board in deciseconds (0.1s). Saturates at 255.
Time since the last healthy message from the engine control board in deciseconds (0.1s). Saturates at 255.

Acceleration along body X-axis (forward) [m/s^2]
Acceleration along body Y-axis (right) [m/s^2]
Acceleration along body Z-axis (down) [m/s^2]

message.name: RFS_ACTUATORS_STATES
message.description: This message signals the states of the valve actuators on the RFS. This is based on whether they are powered or not.
message.field: The unix timestamp when this message was created
The openness of the LOX fill valve (`lox_fll_vlv`), ranges from 0.0 being fully closed to 1.0 being fully open. NaN if unhealthy.
The state of the GOX purge valve (`gox_prg_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the H2 purge valve (`h2_prg_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the N2 bleed valve (`n2_bld_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the LOX purge valve (`lox_prg_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the GOX bleed valve (`gox_bld_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the N2 purge valve (`n2_prg_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the N2 fill valve (`n2_fll_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the H2 bleed valve (`h2_bld_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the LOX bleed valve (`lox_bld_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the Booster valve (`pnm_bstr_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the LOX decoupler retract valve (`pnm_loxdec_ret`), 0 being closed, 1 being open. Cannot be open when extend valve is open.
The state of the LOX decoupler extend valve (`pnm_loxdec_ext`), 0 being closed, 1 being open. Cannot be open when retract valve is open.
The state of the LOX decoupler according to the proximity sensors, 0 being not-retracted, 1 being fully retracted
The state of the N2 decoupler retract valve (`pnm_n2dec_ret`), 0 being closed, 1 being open. Cannot be open when extend valve is open.
The state of the N2 decoupler extend valve (`pnm_n2dec_ext`), 0 being closed, 1 being open. Cannot be open when retract valve is open.
The state of the N2 decoupler according to the proximity sensors, 0 being not-retracted, 1 being fully retracted
The state of the N2 release valve (`pnm_n2rls_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the H2 igniter valve (`h2_ign_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the GOX igniter valve (`gox_ign_vlv`), 0 being closed, 1 being open
The state of the Igniter spark (`ign_spk_plg`), 0 being off, 1 being on
